title: Prism & Caustic Aquarium
summary: A real-time WebGL2 optical aquarium with raymarched dispersion, a 360k-photon caustic light map, and a volumetric spotlight beam.
description: A single-file WebGL2 optical scene with zero external assets. Raymarches a glass tank, rippling water surface, rising bubbles, rotating glass cube, and crystal prism per spectral R/G/B channel for chromatic dispersion, paired with a 360,000-photon caustic light map, volumetric spotlight shaft with drifting dust motes, and ACES bloom. Drag to orbit (35s auto-orbit when idle), scroll to zoom, press 1–3 to switch lighting presets (Studio Light, Neon Night, Ember Dusk), and press Space to pause.
